name: coldrig
description: Agent-native cold-email infrastructure. Bundles the hosted, 28-tool Coldrig MCP server (domains, mailboxes, campaigns, inbox, metrics, lead disposition) so your agent runs outbound email end to end with one bearer token — no dashboard required. Real sending is live in production (Gmail API, HTTPS/443), plus a free sandbox demo. Signup, billing, screening, and real mailbox provisioning are fully self-serve and automatic; mailbox send-authorization completes on our side after provisioning — you don't wait on a queue or do anything. $99/mo all-in for 5 mailboxes.
